Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Victoria BC hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 16 of the 17 Victoria BC hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 9, the hotel's own site at 2, Amimir.com at 1, goseek.com at 1, Hotels.com at 1, trivago DEALS at 1 and Vio.com at 1. These are the Victoria BC rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Victoria BC hotels

At the 14 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 16% ($20 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 15% at Strathcona Hotel to 16% at The Craigmyle. At 3 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
